meta_description:
310K likes, 1,311 comments - vogueindia on October 28, 2026: "There was a time when Katrina Kaif (@katrinakaif) would call out co-stars for downplaying her achievements mid-interview. These days, she's reconsidering how much attention she gives to public opinion. “We live in a world that wants to blow us around in the ever-changing winds of opinions,” she says. “I just want to focus on this lovely part of my life and where I’m headed.”

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.
